cards.card_text: Which people does he defeat as far as Gaza, from watchtower to fortified city?
cards.verse_text: He defeated the Philistines as far as Gaza and its borders, from watchtower to fortified city.
cards.snippet: He defeated the Philistines as far as Gaza and its borders, from watchtower to fortified city.

cards.card_text: Then he builds a watchtower right in the middle.
cards.verse_text: He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well.
cards.snippet: He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well.

cards.card_text: The owner has his finest vines and a watchtower in the middle.
cards.verse_text: He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well.
cards.snippet: He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well.

cards.card_text: So the lookout shouts that day after day he stands on the watchtower, and night after night he stays at his post.
cards.verse_text: Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
cards.snippet: …the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.

cards.card_text: The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever, "the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks".
cards.verse_text: The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever—the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks—
cards.snippet: The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever—the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for…

cards.card_text: The LORD speaks to the watchtower of the flock, the stronghold of the Daughter of Zion.
cards.verse_text: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion—the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
cards.snippet: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion—the former dominion…

cards.card_text: A man plants a vineyard, puts a wall around it, digs a wine vat and builds a watchtower, and friend, that's not a vineyard anymore, that's a FORTRESS.
cards.verse_text: He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower.
cards.snippet: …put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower.
